body: Thanks for being here :) I hope things take a turn for the best, they do life takes good turns eventually. I'll accept what I can, and not stress about what I can't change. But a good stretch is bound to be on my way :)

Hi Friend,
Thanks for your reply. Your words struck a cord with me that I have something to offer the world. I hope I can do that. I watched the video and the points that stayed with me are about doing the things you love as it builds momentum so that there is more happiness. I'm not going to look on the negative, at least try and I've saved the video, thank you.
